idea-plugin.name: Phalcon RAG Assistant
idea-plugin.description:
An AI-powered assistant for Phalcon PHP developers, integrated directly into PhpStorm.

Ask technical questions about Phalcon, attach selected PHP code as context, and receive answers grounded in official Phalcon documentation and source code.

  • Ask questions directly from PhpStorm.
  • Attach selected PHP code for contextual analysis.
  • View formatted answers with source references.
  • Open referenced Phalcon documentation and source code.
  • Configure the RAG API endpoint in IDE settings.

Requires a running Phalcon RAG backend .
